source: Joe Baker's lines, copied verbatim from JOE DARTY PROJECT.pptx on 26 October 2026. Joe recorded these ten clips in joe darty commentary.m4a; the unrecorded line 'What an own goal' is deliberately omitted.

kick-off.text: Its a lovely day today jeff, i think its going to go well, i think its going to go really well, and i think its going to be a tough match today, jeff

long-range-goal.text: How’s he hit that from outside the box??? Ohhhh what a goal! *clap clap clap* everyones cheering like he’s won the world cup!!! I cant believe it

free-kick-goal.text: What a free kick! Aaawhh, from {player} !

own-goal.text: Ah, I think my grandma could do better than that.

great-save.sourceText: Fantastic save (in a very british voice)

great-save.text: He saved his team from conceding a goal
